builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Hextech Rocket Swarm within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.

Rune reasoning: Heimerdinger — Hextech Rocket Swarm: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: R3 W maximum tooltip total is892+1.83AP across four waves including reduced extra rocket hits. AP/MR penetration strengthen full legal barrage. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. The score is the empowered rocket swarm, not base W. Verify the empowerment's ultimate tagging for Axiom on each real wave; compare inactive Axiom at fixed AP and actual rocket count.

kitEvidence.formula:
Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability.

H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals [80 / 100 / 120 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per shot and [100 / 140 / 180 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control.

Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal [135 / 180 / 225 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: [503 / 697.5 / 892 + (1.83) × AP] magic damage. 

CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing [100 / 200 / 300 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger.

Recast: Cancel this Ability.
